note.question: How should one maximize and distribute the benefits of an on-demand workforce through coordinating self-interested parties in the staffing system?
note.overview: With the rapid growth of the gig economy, on-demand staffing platforms have emerged to help companies manage their temporary workforce. This emerging business-to-business context motivates us to study a new form of supply chain coordination problem. The model considers a staffing platform managing an on-demand workforce to serve multiple firms facing stochastic labor demand.
